title: P0 MCP endpoint 回归保护测试 (learning + workspace)
description: 为 P0 关键 MCP endpoints 补全回归保护测试：learning.ts 含 6 个 endpoint handler（import/style-feedback/style-drift/rules/reading-session/reading-extract/status），workspace.ts 含 workspaceContextEndpoint。当前零测试覆盖。
action: Create learning-endpoints.test.ts and workspace-endpoints.test.ts under src-ts/tests/mcp/ using makeRequest() helper + direct import pattern from memory-endpoints.test.ts

criteria: cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/learning-endpoints.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/workspace-endpoints.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
convergence.verification: Run vitest for each new test file in src-ts/ and confirm all pass with 0 failures
convergence.definition_of_done: learning 和 workspace MCP endpoint 均有回归测试，覆盖请求解析、scope 解析、错误返回（400）、边界条件，所有测试通过

files.change: Create makeRequest helper + test suite covering: learningImportEndpoint (empty content → 400, valid content → 200, default sourceType/sourceName), learningStyleFeedbackEndpoint (missing dimension → 400, invalid action → 400, valid accept/reject/modify), learningStyleDriftEndpoint (empty dimensions → 400, valid dimensions → 200), learningRulesEndpoint (returns 200 with rules array), learningReadingSessionEndpoint (missing bookId → 400, totalChapters<=0 → 400, valid session), learningReadingExtractEndpoint (empty content → 400, valid content → 200), learningStatusEndpoint (returns capabilities array)

Create makeRequest helper + test suite covering: workspaceContextEndpoint with empty body (normalizes to default), with valid workspace object (returns normalized + summary + compatibility), missing body/null (falls back to empty), NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE env var resolution

implementation: Read learning.ts to catalog all 7 endpoint handlers: learningImportEndpoint, learningStyleFeedbackEndpoint, learningStyleDriftEndpoint, learningRulesEndpoint, learningReadingSessionEndpoint, learningReadingExtractEndpoint, learningStatusEndpoint

Create src-ts/tests/mcp/learning-endpoints.test.ts: import { describe, expect, it, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest', define makeRequest(body): HttpRequest helper, import each endpoint from ../../mcp/endpoints/learning.js

For learningImportEndpoint: test empty content returns 400 with error 'content is required', test valid content returns 200 with message/input/sourceName/sourceType/contentLength, test default sourceType='document' and sourceName='unknown'
For learningStyleFeedbackEndpoint: test missing dimension returns 400, test invalid action returns 400, test valid accept/reject/modify actions return 200 with evidence object
For learningStyleDriftEndpoint: test empty dimensions returns 400, test valid dimensions returns 200 with dimensionCount
For learningRulesEndpoint: test returns 200 with rules array (even if empty)
For learningReadingSessionEndpoint: test missing bookId returns 400, test totalChapters<=0 returns 400, test valid session returns 200 with session object
For learningReadingExtractEndpoint: test empty content returns 400, test valid content returns 200 with input/bookId/contentLength
For learningStatusEndpoint: test returns 200 with capabilities array containing IMPORT, SELF_EVOLVING, READING
Read workspace.ts to understand workspaceContextEndpoint: parseBody → normalizeProjectWorkspaceContext → jsonResponse with workspace + summary + compatibility

Create src-ts/tests/mcp/workspace-endpoints.test.ts: define makeRequest helper, test workspaceContextEndpoint with empty body returns normalized default workspace, test with populated workspace object returns normalized + summary fields, test null body falls back gracefully, test NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE env var affects resolveWorkspaceRoot()

commands: cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/learning-endpoints.test.ts --reporter=verbose
cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/workspace-endpoints.test.ts --reporter=verbose

reference.pattern: MCP endpoint test pattern (makeRequest helper + direct import, afterEach vi.clearAllMocks + vi.resetModules)

rationale.chosen_approach: Follow existing MCP endpoint test pattern exactly (makeRequest helper, direct import after vi.mock, afterEach cleanup) to maintain consistency with src-ts/tests/mcp/ directory conventions
decision_factors: learning.ts has 7 endpoint handlers with zero test coverage — P0 regression risk
workspace.ts has 1 endpoint handler with zero test coverage — P0 regression risk
Both are pure HTTP handlers using shared http-types.ts (parseBody, jsonResponse)
No service-level mocking needed — these endpoints parse, validate, and return structured responses
rationale.tradeoffs: Learning endpoints have no external service dependencies (they parse and return directly), so tests are simpler than memory/chat endpoints that need vi.mock for services

risks: workspaceContextEndpoint calls resolveWorkspaceRoot() which reads process.env — may need to set NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE in beforeEach/afterEach similar to chat-endpoints.test.ts pattern
learningStatusEndpoint returns capabilities with LearningCapability enum values — verify enum imports work in test context
